name: intermediate-reversion-horizons
rationale: Nearby-value probe between two measured points of the dominant mean-reversion family's horizon. Baseline (rsi 42 / bollinger 60) had Sharpe +0.008 at 50,000 JPY on 2026-09-25; `longer-reversion-horizons` (rsi 90 / bollinger 120) lifted it to 8.63 and cut 500,000 JPY trades 833 -> 365 (Sharpe -16.69 -> -3.19), but made only 1 trade at 50,000 JPY -- effectively the static mix, so it was rejected on trade count and was not evidence about the signal. The shorter direction (`reversion-horizon-15m`) was clearly worse. rsi 60 / bollinger 90 (1.4-1.5x baseline) tests whether part of the slower-reversion benefit is available while the composite still swings far enough to clear the 0.001 BTC lot floor (~27% of a 50,000 JPY portfolio) often enough to keep >= 50% of baseline trades. Trend-family periods are left unchanged so the effect is attributable to the reversion horizon alone.
